OCTOCODE_CARGO.description: Override the cargo executable used for Rust dependency-graph analysis.

settings.version: The configuration file no longer declares a schema version; delete the key.
settings.classification.type: The classification provider is built in; delete the key.
settings.network.timeout: Request timeout is fixed at 30 s; delete the key.
settings.network.maxRetries: Retries are fixed at 3; delete the key.
settings.network.maxRateLimitWait: The GitHub rate-limit wait is fixed at 45 s; delete the key.
settings.lsp.maxMemoryMb: The language-server memory cap is host-derived (25% of RAM, 4096–8192 MiB); set maxMemoryMb per server in lsp-servers.json instead, and delete the key.
settings.output.pagination: The automatic response page is fixed at 20,000 characters; set responseLength (up to 50,000) on a call instead, and delete the section.
settings.storage.cloneCache: The clone cache is fixed at a 24 h TTL, 2 GiB and 50 repositories; delete the section.
settings.classification.maxConcurrency: Classification concurrency is fixed at 10 in-flight requests per endpoint; delete the key.
settings.classification.maxCandidates: Context selection is fixed at 64 candidates per operation; delete the key.
settings.classification.maxChars: Context selection is fixed at 131,072 characters per operation; delete the key.
settings.classification.timeoutMs: The context selection deadline is fixed at 10 s; delete the key.

environment.OCTOCODE_CLASSIFICATION_TYPE: The classification provider is built in; unset the variable.
environment.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: Request timeout is fixed at 30 s; unset the variable.
environment.MAX_RETRIES: Retries are fixed at 3; unset the variable.
environment.OCTOCODE_MAX_RATE_LIMIT_WAIT: The GitHub rate-limit wait is fixed at 45 s; unset the variable.
environment.OCTOCODE_LSP_MAX_MEMORY_MB: The language-server memory cap is host-derived (25% of RAM, 4096–8192 MiB); set maxMemoryMb per server in lsp-servers.json instead, and unset the variable.
environment.OCTOCODE_OUTPUT_DEFAULT_CHAR_LENGTH: The automatic response page is fixed at 20,000 characters; set responseLength (up to 50,000) on a call instead, and unset the variable.
environment.OCTOCODE_CACHE_TTL_MS: The clone cache TTL is fixed at 24 h; unset the variable.
environment.OCTOCODE_MAX_CACHE_SIZE: The clone cache size is fixed at 2 GiB; unset the variable.
environment.OCTOCODE_MAX_CLONES: The clone cache keeps at most 50 repositories; unset the variable.
environment.OCTOCODE_CLASSIFICATION_CONCURRENCY: Classification concurrency is fixed at 10 in-flight requests per endpoint; unset the variable.
environment.OCTOCODE_CLASSIFICATION_MAX_CANDIDATES: Context selection is fixed at 64 candidates per operation; unset the variable.
environment.OCTOCODE_CLASSIFICATION_MAX_CHARS: Context selection is fixed at 131,072 characters per operation; unset the variable.
environment.OCTOCODE_CLASSIFICATION_TIMEOUT_MS: The context selection deadline is fixed at 10 s; unset the variable.

apiUrl.description: GitHub REST API root. GitHub Enterprise commonly uses /api/v3.

graphqlEnabled.description: Use GitHub GraphQL where supported; false forces REST-only access.

enabled.description: Enable local filesystem tools on every runtime surface.

beta.description: Enable beta features and tools; off by default on every surface. `octocode schema` reports which tools the gate withholds.

allowedPaths.description: Extra absolute or home-relative roots added to the allowed roots (workspace root and OCTOCODE_HOME).
allowedPaths.notes: The environment value is a comma-separated list.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional absolute or home-relative workspace root.

enabled.description: Strict tool allowlist replacing the default tool set.

disabled.description: Tools removed from the default tool set.

deferred.description: Available tools left out of tools/list; one run({tool, query}) tool executes them and next/hints leads that name them.

allowPrivateRegistry.description: Allow private, loopback, or link-local artifact registries.
allowPrivateRegistry.notes: Security-sensitive SSRF escape hatch; opt in only for trusted enterprise registries.

configPath.description: Optional path to a custom lsp-servers.json.

autoInstall.description: Whether `octocode lsp-server install` may download a managed language server: prompt (ask), off, or auto.

cacheDir.description: Directory for managed language-server installs; default <octocode home>/lsp.

trustProjectConfig.description: Trust a project .octocode/lsp-servers.json. Security-sensitive: a trusted project config can launch server binaries.

prewarm.description: Language-server prewarm: targeted starts the server an offered lspSearch call names; all also warms the file a read or search names; off disables it.

format.description: Encoding of rendered text content (the MCP text channel): yaml or json. Structured content is always JSON. The CLI prints this text unless --json.

redactEmails.description: Mask email addresses such as GitHub commit authors.

mode.description: Whether caches and runtime state may persist on disk.

stats.description: Write stats.json on flush; stats remain in memory either way.

api.description: Classification provider API key, required for read-tool classifiers and the beta clasify tool.
api.notes: Credential values are omitted from resolved configuration and diagnostics.

apiHost.description: Optional override of the classification provider's default API root.
apiHost.notes: Requires HTTP or HTTPS at config validation; provider policy may require HTTPS except loopback.

model.description: Classification model for read-tool classifiers and clasify; a clasify row's model overrides it.
model.notes: Pin an exact model (for example jev-1.13.0) for reproducible results; an alias can change behind cached answers until they expire.
